entities.summary: Emerald Park is a theme park destination in Ashbourne, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: Ireland’s strongest ride-led destination, combining major coasters with broad family attractions in a full-day park. This entry is intended for 5–teen travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.

entities.summary: Bunratty Castle and Folk Park is a living history destination in Bunratty, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.

This entry is intended for 5–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
